description: This file defines the interface 'FieldElement' which represents elements of a mathematical field, including methods for addition, subtraction, negation, multiplication, division, reciprocal, and obtaining the associated field. It serves as a core mathematical abstraction within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: FieldElement
classes.description: An interface representing elements within a mathematical field, providing methods for algebraic operations and field membership retrieval.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new element representing the sum of this element and the specified element.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Returns a new element representing the difference between this element and the specified element.

methods.name: negate
methods.description: Returns the additive inverse of this element.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Returns a new element representing this element multiplied by an integer n.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Returns a new element representing the product of this element and the specified element.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Returns a new element representing this element divided by the specified element.

methods.name: reciprocal
methods.description: Returns the multiplicative inverse of this element.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the Field to which this element belongs.
